---
title: "ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications"
---

Hi, I am ZeXin. This site is where I keep my coursework for ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications at SMU.

Most of the work here is built in R and Quarto. The hands-on exercises walk through the techniques we cover each week, starting from the basics of ggplot2 and moving into interactive charts, network graphs, text analysis, and time series. The take-home exercises are larger pieces where I apply those techniques to a real dataset and try to tell a clear story with the results.

Use the cards below or the menu at the top to explore.
